title: Non-Profit Organisations (Record Keeping Threshold) Order, 2025
text:
No. 31] Non-Profit Organisations 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 31 of 2025
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for non-profit
organisations, on the recommendation of the Financial
Services Commission after consultation with the National
Anti-Money Laundering Committee, in exercise of the
powers conferred upon him by section 17 of the Non-
Profit Organisations Act, (Act No. 14 of 2023), and all
other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 1st March, 2025)
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation.
NON-PROFIT ORGANISATIONS (RECORD
KEEPING THRESHOLD) ORDER, 2025.
2. It is hereby specified that any Non-Profit Organisation Threshold for
record keeping.
that receives $15,000.00 or more in donations from a single
donor during any financial year shall be required to take
reasonable steps to document and keep records of the identity
of that donor.
MADE by the Minister responsible for non-profit organisations
on the recommendation of the Financial Services Commission
after consultation with the National Anti-Money Laundering
Committee this 27th day of February 2025.
HON. JOHN BRICEÑO
Prime Minister and Minister of Finance,
Economic Development and Investment,
Civil Aviation and Immigration
(Minister responsible for Non-Profit Organisations)
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan
